description: Details for one product_id: description, images, sizes and colours, and its price and delivery at the ZIP.

market.description: Market key, e.g. san-antonio-tx. Used when no zip is given.

zip.description: 5-digit US ZIP code, for local prices and delivery options.

name: get_product

delivery_promise.description: Local delivery: "Get it today" or "We'll deliver by <Month D>". Ship-to-home: "Ships to you".

price.description: Unit price in USD, before the delivery or shipping fee. Absent on a size or colour family: pick a variant.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable reason, alongside the prose note.

size.description: Absent when none is recorded; the size may then be in the title.

url.description: Product page on JENNi, already carrying the shopper's ZIP.

variants.description: Sizes or colours, each with its own product_id. For a family (no price), get_buying_options and start_checkout need a variant's product_id.

label.description: The source's own option text, word for word, when the variant has no size or colour.

title: Product details
